name: Attentive
description: Attentive is a mobile-first customer engagement platform for SMS, email, subscriber growth, journeys, behavioral events, attributes, product catalogs, privacy requests, webhooks, and audience segments.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated customer-owned private-app key with only the permissions agents need. Relay exposes all 32 currently published v1/v2 data operations: eight structural reads run directly, three subscriber/privacy reads and all 21 mutations require approval, and legacy direct-message APIs and bulk-result downloads remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: ATTENTIVE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Attentive private-app API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated private custom app, grant only selected API permissions, and copy its one-time key directly into Relay's encrypted credential form.

capabilities.label: Read account structure
capabilities.description: Use eight bounded non-subscriber reads across company, webhook, catalog, segment, and redacted bulk-job metadata.

capabilities.label: Read subscriber data
capabilities.description: Use three exact subscriber-attribute, subscription-eligibility, and privacy-request reads with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage messaging data
capabilities.description: Use 21 mutations for events, subscriptions, attributes, identity, catalogs, webhooks, privacy, bulk jobs, and segments with approval.

allowed.label: Read Attentive structure
allowed.description: Read company binding, webhook structure, catalog ingestion, bounded segments, and redacted bulk-job status.

approvalRequired.label: Read subscriber or privacy data
approvalRequired.description: Read one user's attributes or subscription eligibility, or one privacy-delete request.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Attentive
approvalRequired.description: Create events, subscriptions, attributes, identifiers, catalogs, webhooks, segments, bulk jobs, or privacy requests.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Private-app API keys and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Use legacy messaging APIs
blocked.description: Legacy direct SMS/MMS and legacy subscriber endpoints use separate tokens and remain outside this connector.

blocked.label: Download bulk results
blocked.description: Bulk-job download URLs and result files can contain personal data and are redacted and blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary or unbounded APIs
blocked.description: Only 32 published v1/v2 operations run; arbitrary paths, headers, origins, pagination loops, and oversized transfers are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Eight structural reads run directly; all subscriber/privacy reads and mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 32 selected and private-app-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed routes, bounds, redaction, audits, provider permissions, and legacy/download blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the selected pinned Attentive tools and attaches the encrypted private-app key server-side.
Railway mounts the selected pinned Attentive tools and attaches the encrypted private-app key server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A representative Attentive account owner must create a dedicated private custom app, select the intended permissions, copy its one-time API key, and configure staging. This worker may not open the provider console or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the dedicated private app under an authorized owner, grant only the selected APIs, store the one-time key in Railway staging, and verify exact company binding, structural reads, subscriber-read approvals, one reversible approved mutation, provider denials, key regeneration, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Attentive documents customer-private apps using bearer API keys, public apps using authorization-code OAuth with non-expiring access tokens, the /me binding check, and currently published OAuth scopes.
Private custom apps select API permissions, issue a one-time-visible API key, support independent key regeneration, and can be deleted to revoke the integration.

The current v1 OpenAPI publishes 21 data operations after excluding authorization-code token exchange across binding, webhooks, events, coupons, attributes, subscriptions, catalogs, privacy, and identity.
The current v2 OpenAPI publishes 11 operations for company binding, user attributes, bulk jobs, bulk membership, and segment lifecycle.
Attentive documents endpoint-specific rate limits, 429 handling, and x-ratelimit response headers; Relay exposes those headers without automatic retry storms.
